mapper.select: SELECT curriculum_item_id, user_id, main_chapter_id, status, completed_at FROM user_curriculum_items WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND main_chapter_id = #{mainChapterId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sub_chapters WHERE main_chapter_id = #{mainChapterId} AND is_active = TRUE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sub_chapters sub WHERE sub.main_chapter_id = #{mainChapterId} AND sub.is_active = TRUE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_learning_progress progress WHERE progress.user_id = #{userId} AND progress.sub_chapter_id = sub.sub_chapter_id AND progress.status = 'COMPLETED' )
